visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four figures stand on a green baseball field under bright stadium lights. On the far left, a professional baseball player wearing a light blue and white uniform with a matching cap and a glove on his left hand smiles while holding his right hand up to form half of a heart. Next to him, a young woman with long black hair, dressed in a black top and white pleated skirt, completes the other half of the heart with her hand. A middle-aged man in a blue t-shirt and dark pants stands beside her, followed by a dark grey wolf mascot wearing a white and blue baseball jersey. The background consists of a green outfield grass area and a low fence featuring several commercial logos including "BANK OF TAIWAN". (2) The scene transitions via a quick cut to a wide-angle view of the interior of a massive baseball stadium. In the center of the frame, a huge LED display screen is showing the same group of people—the player and the young woman—continuing their heart-shaped hand gesture. The stadium stands are filled with a large crowd of spectators, appearing as a blurred mass of colors and lights. The bright overhead stadium lights illuminate the entire field and seating area, creating a vibrant and high-energy atmosphere. (3) The camera cuts to a close-up framing the baseball player and the young woman from the chest up. Both are smiling brightly and looking directly at the camera. Their hands are positioned in front of their chests, perfectly completing a heart shape. The player's blue jersey shows some text and a logo on the sleeve, and he wears a device on his cap. The woman's long hair is styled straight, and her expression is one of pure happiness. The background is slightly out of focus, showing the green color of the field and the distant stadium structures.
